dedupe_keys.name: citt metropolitana di catania elenco delle aree di circolazione

description: Città Metropolitana di Catania publishes this tabular list of circulation areas through the Maggioli open data catalogue. Native field metadata lists five columns: Codvia, Specie, Descrizione, Cap and Comune. These identify a street reference table with codes, classification labels, descriptions, postcodes and municipalities. Coverage follows the publishing municipality; geographic completeness has not been checked. The source offers one CSV distribution. Package metadata names the Open Data Commons Attribution License, while the CSV distribution names CC BY 4.0. The applicable licence remains uncertain. Metadata is publicly readable, but the reviewed source does not state a charge for obtaining or using the file. The inspected schema provides no coordinates or road-link connectivity. A documented simulation application is not supplied, so no simulation method is assigned. The declared update frequency is annual; its operation has not been independently verified. Accuracy, completeness and individual field values remain unverified. The related Catania AINOP road-code dataset records road sections, kilometre endpoints, length and AINOP codes; this street directory has its own native identity and five-field schema. No dataset rows or download body were read.
